'''Quintis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he met with [[Ashara Zavros]] to discuss the possibility of peace with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Quintis is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Ashara Zavros companion storyline.
